title: Marketing Automation Specialist
summary: Marketing automation specialists set up the automatic emails, push notifications and messages that reach customers at the right moment, such as welcome, reminder and win-back journeys. They sit in a marketing, CRM or growth team and work with product, sales and design to grow sign-ups, repeat use and leads.
dailyDuties: Build and test journeys and campaigns in the automation platform
Create audience segments from user data
Set up A/B tests on messages, timing and offers
Report campaign results and suggest changes
Plan the campaign calendar with product and growth teams

skills.expectation: Build programs and journeys in Marketo, HubSpot or Salesforce Marketing Cloud
Run push, in-app, email and WhatsApp campaigns in MoEngage, CleverTap, WebEngage or Braze
Design onboarding, nurture, retention and win-back journeys triggered by user behaviour
Build segments from user events, attributes and lifecycle stage
Plan and send email campaigns with good templates and copy
Protect sender reputation with SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warm-up and list hygiene
A/B test subject lines, content, timing and journeys and read the results
Report campaign results and analyse performance data
Report campaign results and analyse performance data
Work with product, growth, sales and design teams on campaign plans
Set up lead scoring and routing for B2B funnels
Keep CRM and automation data in sync
Track campaign traffic and conversions with UTM tags and analytics

groups.label: A marketing automation or customer engagement platform
Campaign reporting in Excel or SQL

certifications.why: Free course covering inbound and nurture basics
Shows you can track campaign traffic and conversions
